note: Handshake transport only: send an `initialize` request first. This server does NOT yet support the 2026-07-28 era (per-request _meta, server/discover) — a client built for it will receive "Server not initialized". Newest negotiable version: 2025-11-25.
name: finn-tannlege
title: Finn-tannlege — Norwegian dental clinic search
description: Search and compare 5 447 Norwegian dental clinics. Filter by county (fylke), specialty, Helfo direct-billing agreement, and emergency-duty (akuttvakt) availability. Supports natural-language queries in Norwegian and English.

endpoints.description: Remote MCP HTTP transport (Streamable HTTP). Compatible with ChatGPT connectors and remote Claude.

tools.name: tannlege_search
tools.description: Search Norwegian dental clinics by free text, county (fylke), specialty, Helfo agreement, and emergency-duty filters.

tools.name: tannlege_info
tools.description: Fetch full profile for a single dental clinic by organisation number (org_nr) or UUID.

tools.name: tannlege_stats
tools.description: Fetch aggregated Norwegian dental market statistics — totals, per-county breakdown, Helfo/chain/emergency-duty counts.

tools.name: tannlege_akutt
tools.description: Find dental clinics offering emergency-duty (akuttvakt) treatment, optionally filtered by county.

tools.name: tannlege_kjeder
tools.description: List Norwegian dental chains (kjeder) with a count of clinic locations per chain.

authentication.description: All MCP tools are read-only and require no authentication.
